# Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

Offline-first data synchronization for .NET MAUI. Local SQLite writes, change tracking, conflict resolution, and pluggable remote sync.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-offline-sync
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

Registration: `UseOfflineSync` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I build offline-first CRUD in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI SQLite sync with conflict resolution
- Queue local writes and sync when online

## Do not use when

- The team already standardized on Realm, Azure Mobile Apps, or Cosmos offline
- You only need a local SQLite cache with no sync protocol
